newsletter.subject: Ridgeback lift the cup
newsletter.text:
FINAL: Ridgeback FC 3-1 Ostler Town.
Ridgeback won the Coastal Cup final in front of 31,000 fans, with two goals from striker Tomas Abend.
It is the club's first trophy in 17 years.

referenceSummary: Ridgeback FC beat Ostler Town 3 to 1 to win the Coastal Cup final, their first trophy in 17 years, with two goals from Tomas Abend.
